title: 電影院找空位
question:
電影院有 4 排、每排 5 個位置，0 是空位、1 是有人坐。請一排一排輸入，存進 4 列 5 行的表格。
先輸出每一排有幾個空位（一排一行），最後輸出「第 幾 排」空位最多（排從 1 開始數；一樣多的話選前面那一排）。

test_case.note: 第 1、2 排一樣多，選前面的

en.title: Find Empty Seats
en.question:
A movie theater has 4 rows with 5 seats each. 0 is an empty seat and 1 is taken. Input the seats row by row into a table with 4 rows and 5 columns.
First output how many empty seats each row has (one row per line). At the end, output "Row " and the row with the most empty seats (rows start from 1; if two rows tie, choose the first one).

test_case.note: Rows 1 and 2 tie: choose the first
